found: T8 run 1, verify 1 (the creator's prompt through the headless loop, no hand edits): gate A measure 18 failed on 37 sounds in the look step's own option copy inside the game (.look/options/faithful/game/audio/audio.js), and gate B measure 3 (and gate E's loadout leg) on "mechanic aim.update threw TypeError: Failed to execute 'linearRampToValueAtTime' on 'AudioParam': The provided float value is non-finite". Neither is the game's to fix; together they cost a whole repair round. T1 run 1 failed measure 18 the same way.
rootCause: Measure 18 (builder/tools/lib/sounds-check.mjs) walked every folder of the game but a few named ones, so the loop's and the tools' own dot folders (the look step's option copies, the loop's state, .verify) were read as the game's code.

The aim part made a non-local shooter's shell view before copying the shell's position into it, so its fire sound went to ctx.audio.play with at {x: undefined}; the kit's positional wrapper turned that into a NaN pan and gain, and the audio graph threw inside the part's update on every bot shot.
fix: sounds-check skips every folder whose name starts with a dot (regression look-copies-not-the-game: a look option's copy that plays unlisted sounds passes measure 18).

ctx.audio.play (three and forge boots) plays a sound whose place has a non-finite coordinate unplaced; aim copies the place before newShell (regression sound-at-unknown-place: rules that ask for a sound at an undefined place every frame boot with no console error, gate B).
